changes.rationale: Astragaloside IV, the principal characterised constituent of Astragalus membranaceus, inhibited the EGFR-driven PI3K/Akt/NF-κB axis and reduced oxidative-stress markers in rat gastric mucosa and GES-1 cells. [enrichment-pipeline job job_39ccfd77b18e1eee, candidate cand_718b5a8fbf3c8e85]

Total polysaccharides from Rhizoma Atractylodis Macrocephalae activated RAW 264.7 macrophages, raising NO, ROS, cytokine and chemokine output through NF-κB and JAK-STAT. NF-kB inhibition is explicitly NOT claimed: here NF-κB translocation is the activating event, the opposite direction. [enrichment-pipeline job job_ac9950f890861651, candidate cand_2dcbf6c441e85667]

AKBA, the boswellic acid Boswellia serrata gum resin is standardised for, lowered phosphorylated IκB-α (the NF-κB activation step) and carbonyl protein content in LPS-treated mice. 5-LO inhibition is stated as background in this paper rather than measured, so LOX inhibition is not claimed from it. [enrichment-pipeline job job_b8ca037969c0ea89, candidate cand_53aee617f5d87c9a]

All three petasins from Petasites hybridus inhibited leukotriene synthesis in primed human eosinophils; petasin additionally prevented 5-lipoxygenase translocation to the nuclear envelope and blocked ECP release. The calcium effect is not claimed as Calcium-channel modulation: the authors attribute it to signalling at or proximal to PLCβ, not to channel block. [enrichment-pipeline job job_9e783bcb545712c4, candidate cand_916fba60e797ea41]

Expression cloning of the capsaicin receptor from sensory neurons: capsaicin, the pungent principle of Capsicum, selectively activates this non-selective cation channel of the TRP family. Metabolic Regulation, the entity's current mechanism_summary, is not claimed here — the retrievable thermogenesis evidence is in reviews rather than the primary literature this field accepts. [enrichment-pipeline job job_8a658bfdb006eeef, candidate cand_7b068112666f4a36]

Forskolin, the diterpene Coleus forskohlii is standardised for, raised hippocampal CREB ser133 phosphorylation and reduced neuronal damage in the prefrontal cortex, hippocampus and cerebellum. The adenylyl-cyclase/cAMP step itself has no label in the vocabulary; the demonstrated downstream effect does. [enrichment-pipeline job job_bd96ed7bfdfb0a93, candidate cand_5c55a4d0f11903c7]

Anethole, the principal constituent of fennel volatile oil, suppressed NF-κB phosphorylation alongside AKT, ERK and p38 in HT-1080 cells. Confidence is low because the evidence is for the isolated constituent in a tumour-cell model, not for a fennel preparation. [enrichment-pipeline job job_3e58cb0d0b4b2dd6, candidate cand_dee0f254ed11fbc5]

Ginkgo biloba extract activated Nrf2 translocation and ARE binding, induced HO-1, and reduced cytokine-induced endothelial adhesiveness in human aortic endothelial cells and injured arteries in vivo. Antioxidant is deliberately NOT claimed: the paper's own finding is that the effect is antioxidant-independent and PEG-SOD did not alter it. [enrichment-pipeline job job_3b23cf705df58943, candidate cand_772faac793a5c6be]

changes.new_value: NF-kB inhibition; Vascular function support; Gut microbiome modulation
changes.rationale: Glycyrrhizic acid reversed gut dysbiosis and shifted microbial tryptophan metabolism; the resulting indole-3-lactic acid activated AhR, which bound NF-κB p65 and blocked its nuclear translocation, suppressing endothelial adhesion-molecule expression. Antibiotic depletion and faecal transplant established the microbiota dependence. [enrichment-pipeline job job_979a97f533dd77f4, candidate cand_ef315d539ad5c36f]
Cyathane diterpenes isolated from H. erinaceus liquid culture promoted neurite outgrowth in PC12 cells at 2.5-10 μM. [enrichment-pipeline job job_0b9e7ed349516784, candidate cand_5722e9bdecd37416]

changes.new_value: Lipid metabolism support; Vascular function support
changes.rationale: H. sabdariffa infusion altered the hepatic fatty-acid profile and desaturase activity in metabolic-syndrome rats and improved the impaired vascular reactivity that accompanied it. [enrichment-pipeline job job_4090f94d994cad84, candidate cand_1d17cd4d5f415f83]

Crude extracts, solvent partitions and isolated valeriana-type iridoid glycosides from N. jatamansi rhizome all protected SH-SY5Y neuroblastoma cells against hydrogen-peroxide toxicity on viability and antioxidation assays. [enrichment-pipeline job job_7744c48b627a4bf1, candidate cand_ed7b3b73bfba6248]

Randomised placebo-controlled PET cross-over in 17 healthy men: 160 mg/day Silexan, an essential oil from Lavandula angustifolia flowers, significantly reduced 5-HT1A receptor binding potential in temporal, fusiform, hippocampal, insular and anterior cingulate clusters. The study reports receptor-level engagement, not a clinical outcome. [enrichment-pipeline job job_874348004e95211f, candidate cand_ac808e80f61ddeae]

Cymbopogon citratus extracts reduced brain lipid peroxidation (TBARS) induced by three different pro-oxidants and scavenged DPPH radicals. Melissa officinalis was the strongest of the three plants tested; the C. citratus effect is real but not the paper's headline. [enrichment-pipeline job job_a28979225191f199, candidate cand_60bcbe4d134ad1e2]

Apigenin, isolated from the aqueous extract of M. recutita flower heads, competitively inhibited flunitrazepam binding at the central benzodiazepine site of the GABA-A receptor (Ki 4 μM) and was anxiolytic in the elevated plus-maze without sedation or myorelaxation at comparable doses. [enrichment-pipeline job job_b05387e55f78854b, candidate cand_56b8d62b530224f4]

Menthol reduced spontaneous contractions of human distal colon circular muscle; nifedipine attenuated the effect and the response survived TRPM8 antagonism, neural blockade, guanylyl-cyclase inhibition and K+-channel block. TRPV1/TRPM8 activation, which the entity's mechanism_summary names, is specifically what this paper rules out as the spasmolytic route. [enrichment-pipeline job job_372303c20a6a0e53, candidate cand_490d978204018c51]

Menthol, the major constituent of peppermint oil, inhibited human colonic circular-muscle contractility through block of L-type Ca2+ influx; the effect was nifedipine-sensitive and TRPM8-independent. [enrichment-pipeline job job_c43d3cdf4a498806, candidate cand_d72e75621e44a580]
changes.shared_value_acknowledged: Same value as `peppermint`, from the same source. Peppermint oil is the preparation the menthol evidence was generated from, so the mechanism is identical by construction; the two entities are a whole-herb / preparation split, not a duplicate.

changes.rationale: All four botanicals sold as Shankhpushpi were assayed for acetylcholinesterase inhibition, antioxidant capacity and 5-LOX inhibition. Confidence is low deliberately: activity was strongly variety-dependent, with Evolvulus alsinoides clearly superior and Convolvulus pluricaulis among the weakest, and the trade name does not fix which species is in a given product. [enrichment-pipeline job job_0387619f952dce85, candidate cand_5bfcaa0957c702d0]

PRISMA-guided review of twelve pre-clinical and clinical UC-2 studies: the mechanism reported is oral tolerance, a specific immune-mediated route, with downstream reduction in joint inflammation. [enrichment-pipeline job job_413fe642cea36247, candidate cand_bcb82faf9122d89e]
